_comment: THE BUILDER REPORT. The second of the two documents about a person: the session card
says what just happened, and this says how they build and whether it is changing.
NOTHING IN HERE IS WRITTEN BY A MODEL. Every field is a number this machine measured,
which is why there is no JSON Schema output and no `stamped` rule: there is no
constrained decoder to constrain and no claim to take back. What the spec buys is the
same thing it buys everywhere else — one definition, three notations, and a door the
server can close with `extra='forbid'` on a document it did not compute.
scripts/gen_report.py emits, both committed, both `git diff --exit-code`'d in CI:
server/builder/report_spec.py     Pydantic, extra='forbid', on the way into Postgres
mobile/src/generated/report.ts    what the profile screen renders
WHY THE SERVER CANNOT COMPUTE IT. Three of the five blocks rest on things that never
leave the machine (privacy/upload-contract.json): subagent sidecar transcripts, shell
command text, and prompt text. The server has counts, not commands, so it can no more
compute `quality` than it can compute the narrative.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE. `analysis/rules.py` produces CLAUDE.md lines from ERROR
TEXT, which carries paths and file names; it stays on the machine and is written to a
file there. `analysis/playbook.py` splits PROMPTS, so only its counts travel and not one
word of a prompt. Every field below is a number, a date, a metric name or a label from
a fixed table in this repository.
NULL IS NOT ZERO, everywhere in this document. A block is null when it was refused, and
the refusal carries its reason so the phone can say why instead of drawing an empty
chart. A `reason` beside a null number is the difference between 'we do not know' and
'it was nothing'.
VERSION 2 appends five nullable blocks after `languages`: wrapped, money, burn, vocab
and stack (docs/overnight-integration.md section 1), so a v1 document still validates.
A null BLOCK means only that the machine which sent this report does not compute it (an
older capture). A refusal is the block's own `reason` with its numbers null.
INSIDE THE FIVE BLOCKS NO FIELD IS A STRING. Every one is an enum from a fixed table in
this repository, a number or a clock, and every `reason` is an enum code the phone turns
into a sentence with `n` and `needed`. The phone renders every word; nothing rendered
travels (docs/overnight-engine.md rule 5).
Four enums copy a Python table, and a test pins each copy both ways: wrapped_card is
wrapped.CARD_IDS, priced_model is pricing.PRICES, vocab_term is vocab.CATALOG and
stack_item is vocab.STACK. A new row there is an edit here plus `make gen`, never a
migration: the report is stored as JSONB.

ReportTrend.name: metric
ReportTrend.doc: the metric's key, from analysis/profile.py. Stable across versions; the label is not.

ReportTrend.name: label
ReportTrend.doc: the metric in words a person reads, from the one table in analysis/trends.py.

ReportTrend.name: before
ReportTrend.doc: its value over the older of the two equal windows.

ReportTrend.name: now
ReportTrend.doc: its value over the newer window.

ReportTrend.name: move
ReportTrend.doc: the signed relative change, (now - before) / before. 0.7 is up 70 percent.

ReportTrend.name: direction
ReportTrend.doc: up, down, or steady. Steady is a real answer: under the noise floor is not a move.

ReportTrend.name: good
ReportTrend.doc: whether this direction is the one they want, when the metric has a direction at all. Null means the change is reported with no verdict: more hours is not better and a night owl is not broken.

ReportTrend.name: sessions_before
ReportTrend.doc: sittings in the older window. Both windows need a sample or there is no trend.

ReportAgentType.name: name
ReportAgentType.doc: the subagent type, one of the harness's own (analysis/agents.py BUILTIN_AGENT_TYPES); unknown when the sidecar never said, and custom for every name somebody gave their own agent, which is free text and never leaves the machine.

ReportAgentType.name: agents
ReportAgentType.doc: how many instances of that type ran.

ReportAgents.name: agents
ReportAgents.doc: subagent instances that ran in the window. Counted from sidecar transcripts, which every other tool skips.

ReportAgents.name: produced
ReportAgents.doc: how many of them did anything at all: a tool call, a file, an error. An agent that produced nothing is a delegation that cost tokens and returned air.

ReportAgents.name: max_concurrent
ReportAgents.doc: the most that were running at the same moment. A handoff is not two agents at once, so an end sorts before a start at equal timestamps.

ReportAgents.name: agent_seconds
ReportAgents.doc: the sum of every agent's own span. Deliberately larger than wall time when they overlap; that overlap is the point.

ReportAgents.name: wall_seconds
ReportAgents.doc: clock time from the first agent starting to the last one stopping.

ReportAgents.name: busy_seconds
ReportAgents.doc: how much of that stretch had at least one agent running. The union of the spans, so an overlap counts once.

ReportAgents.name: parallelism
ReportAgents.doc: agent_seconds over busy_seconds: while agents were running, how many were running at once. 1.0 is a queue, 3.4 is three and a bit at a time. Never below 1.0 when anything ran, which is why the denominator is the union and not the stretch.

ReportAgents.name: by_type
ReportAgents.doc: the split by subagent type, most common first.

ReportDay.name: day
ReportDay.doc: the day, YYYY-MM-DD, with the 04:00 boundary this repository uses everywhere else.

ReportDay.name: assisted
ReportDay.doc: commits that landed while an agent was working.

ReportDay.name: alone
ReportDay.doc: commits that landed outside every session window. Deliberately generous: anything the capture never saw counts here.

ReportContributions.name: assisted
ReportContributions.doc: commits with an agent in the room.

ReportContributions.name: alone
ReportContributions.doc: commits you wrote on your own.

ReportContributions.name: active_days
ReportContributions.doc: days you shipped something. Not days you opened the app: a streak a tab can extend is a streak about the tab.

ReportContributions.name: longest_streak
ReportContributions.doc: the longest run of consecutive shipping days.

ReportContributions.name: current_streak
ReportContributions.doc: the run ending today or yesterday. Yesterday still counts, because today is not over.

ReportContributions.name: days
ReportContributions.doc: one entry per day that had a commit, oldest first. Days with none are absent rather than zero rows.

ReportGreen.name: n
ReportGreen.doc: how many times a failing test run was followed by a passing one.

ReportGreen.name: median_seconds
ReportGreen.doc: the median of those recoveries. The solo builder's answer to DORA's mean time to restore.

ReportGreen.name: median_attempts
ReportGreen.doc: how many runs it typically took to get back to green.

ReportQuality.name: runs
ReportQuality.doc: test runs seen in the window, counted from shell commands.

ReportQuality.name: passed
ReportQuality.doc: runs with no error after them.

ReportQuality.name: first_try_rate
ReportQuality.doc: the share of test runs that were already green. Not 'the first try worked' per feature, which nothing here can see.

ReportQuality.name: time_to_green
ReportQuality.doc: the recovery numbers, or null when nothing in the window failed and then passed.

ReportQuality.name: reason
ReportQuality.doc: why the rates are null, when they are. Present only on a refusal.

ReportPrompting.name: attempts
ReportPrompting.doc: prompts long enough to be an instruction rather than a nudge.

ReportPrompting.name: clean
ReportPrompting.doc: of those, how many landed something without a correction and without the agent stalling.

ReportPrompting.name: costly
ReportPrompting.doc: how many cost a correction or a long stall.

ReportPrompting.name: clean_share
ReportPrompting.doc: clean over attempts. NO PROMPT TEXT TRAVELS: this is the whole of what the playbook uploads.

ReportPrompting.name: reason
ReportPrompting.doc: why the share is null, when it is.

ReportLanguage.name: name
ReportLanguage.doc: the language, from a fixed table of extensions. `other` is an extension nobody mapped, counted rather than guessed at.

ReportLanguage.name: lines
ReportLanguage.doc: lines the agent added in it.

ReportLanguage.name: files
ReportLanguage.doc: distinct files. A count, never a name: paths do not leave the machine.

ReportLanguage.name: share
ReportLanguage.doc: its share of the attributable lines.

ReportLanguages.name: lines
ReportLanguages.doc: attributable lines in the window, generated files already excluded.

ReportLanguages.name: generated_lines_excluded
ReportLanguages.doc: lines nobody wrote: lockfiles, `node_modules`, this repository's own generated Swift, TypeScript and Python. Reported rather than hidden, because a silent exclusion is indistinguishable from a parser that missed the file.

ReportLanguages.name: languages
ReportLanguages.doc: most lines first, the tail summed into `other`. Null when there were too few attributable lines to split.

ReportLanguages.name: reason
ReportLanguages.doc: why the split is null, when it is.

ReportCoverage.name: window_days
ReportCoverage.doc: the window that was ASKED FOR. Repeated from the top level so this block is readable on its own.

ReportCoverage.name: spans_days
ReportCoverage.doc: the calendar distance from the first sitting on this machine to the last. NOT the same as days built: two sittings a month apart span 30 days and are 2 active days.

ReportCoverage.name: active_days
ReportCoverage.doc: days that actually had a sitting.

ReportCoverage.name: sessions
ReportCoverage.doc: sittings the numbers above rest on.

ReportCoverage.name: first_at
ReportCoverage.doc: the earliest sitting found. Null when there are none.

ReportArchetypeScore.name: name
ReportArchetypeScore.doc: the archetype a rule names, from analysis/profile.py ARCHETYPE_RULES.

ReportArchetypeScore.name: value
ReportArchetypeScore.doc: the metric's value on this corpus. Null when it could not be computed.

ReportArchetypeScore.name: threshold
ReportArchetypeScore.doc: the value the rule needs to win, from ARCHETYPE_RULES. Null when the sender left it out.

ReportArchetypeScore.name: score
ReportArchetypeScore.doc: value over threshold, capped at 2 and halved, a fraction: meeting the threshold exactly scores 0.5. Null when value is.

ReportKindCount.name: kind
ReportKindCount.doc: a kind of change, as a commit subject labels it (wrapped.classify_subject).

ReportKindCount.name: commits
ReportKindCount.doc: commits whose subject says this kind.

ReportRoleLines.name: role
ReportRoleLines.doc: a file role from analysis/plain.py role_of: the path's shape, never its contents.

ReportRoleLines.name: lines
ReportRoleLines.doc: agent lines added to project files of this role.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: confidence
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: builder_type: the archetype's confidence, a fraction: its margin over the runner up, damped below ten sessions.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: metric
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: builder_type: the metric behind the winning rule.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: metric_value
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: builder_type: that metric's value, the number its sentence says.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: metric_lower_bound
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: builder_type: true when that metric's basis says it is a floor, so the sentence says at least.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: closest
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: builder_type, generalist only: the rule that came nearest.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: runners_up
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: builder_type: the next rules by score.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: commits
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: shipped: distinct commits git log found across every repository these sessions ran in. kind_of_work: commit subjects read.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: assisted
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: shipped: of those, commits inside a session window or the lookback before one.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: alone
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: shipped: the rest of them.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: commits_basis
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: shipped: how the commits were counted. Null when no commit history was read.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: autonomy
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: work_style: the share of active time the agent ran with nobody present.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: median_prompts
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: work_style: median prompts over sessions with you there.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: steer_rate
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: work_style: interrupts plus corrections over prompts. A number and not a fraction, because interrupts can outnumber prompts.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: active_seconds
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: longest_session: that session's active seconds, beside the attended seconds in value.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: started_at
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: longest_session: when it started.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: subagents_peak
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: agents_at_once: the most helper agents running at one moment across the corpus.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: subagents
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: agents_at_once: helper agents that ran.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: sessions
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: go_to_prompt: distinct sessions the prompt was sent in.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: words
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: go_to_prompt: its length in words. A count, never the words.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: commit_days
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: streak: days with a commit.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: attended_days
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: streak: days with a session you were there for.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: both_days
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: streak: days with both, the only days a streak can run over.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: interrupts
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: change_course: interrupts counted.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: corrective_prompts
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: change_course: prompts that corrected the agent.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: median
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: prompt_length: median words a prompt. prompts_per_session: median prompts a session.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: avg_minutes
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: deep_sessions: average minutes with you there across the deep sessions.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: longest_minutes
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: deep_sessions: the longest session with you there, in whole minutes, floored.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: attended_hours
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: time_put_in: hours with you there.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: attended_overlap_hours
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: time_put_in: at most this many of the attended hours are counted twice, because sessions ran at the same time. Its sentence says so when it is above 0.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: tool_calls_per_prompt
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: prompts_per_session: tool calls over prompts, across the sessions the card counts.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: kinds
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: kind_of_work: labelled commits by kind, in wrapped.KINDS order, kinds with none left out.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: classified
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: kind_of_work: commit subjects that say what kind of change they are.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: coverage
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: kind_of_work: the share of subjects read that carry a label.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: role_lines
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: kind_of_work: agent lines by file role, in plain.ROLES order, roles with none left out.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: commit_refusal
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: kind_of_work: why the commit labels could not decide the card, when they could not.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: lines
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: kind_of_work: attributable lines the file role fallback read.

ReportWrappedExtras.name: lines_needed
ReportWrappedExtras.doc: kind_of_work: the lines that fallback needs (languages.MIN_LINES).

ReportWrappedCard.name: id
ReportWrappedCard.doc: which of the fifteen questions this card answers. The phone writes the question.

ReportWrappedCard.name: value
ReportWrappedCard.doc: the answer as a number, in `unit`. Null on a refusal, and on a card whose answer is an id.

ReportWrappedCard.name: value_id
ReportWrappedCard.doc: the answer as an id, for the units archetype, style and kind. Null otherwise.

ReportWrappedCard.name: unit
ReportWrappedCard.doc: what value counts. An identifier, never rendered.

ReportWrappedCard.name: basis
ReportWrappedCard.doc: the rule the answer came from, or would have come from.

ReportWrappedCard.name: n
ReportWrappedCard.doc: the sample the answer rests on: sessions, prompts, days, lines or commit subjects, per card.

ReportWrappedCard.name: needed
ReportWrappedCard.doc: the floor a refusal names, read beside n.

ReportWrappedCard.name: reason
ReportWrappedCard.doc: why the card is refused, null when it is answered. The phone writes the sentence from this code, n, needed and the card's numeric extras through wrapped.REFUSALS (generated into copy.ts); the kind of work card's commit half is extras.commit_refusal through wrapped.KIND_REFUSALS.

ReportWrappedCard.name: extras
ReportWrappedCard.doc: the numbers the card's sentence is written from. Always an object: a card sets only its own keys and the rest are null.

ReportWrapped.name: cards
ReportWrapped.doc: all fifteen, in wrapped.CARD_IDS order, answered or refused. crash_out and cryptic_prompt carry only id, unit, basis, n and reason: every other number on them is a reading of what somebody typed.

ReportWrapped.name: prompts_with_text
ReportWrapped.doc: prompts in the person's own words, the pool the prompt cards read.

ReportWrapped.name: attended_sessions
ReportWrapped.doc: sessions with you there, the pool the attended time cards count.

ReportTokens.name: cache_read
ReportTokens.doc: tokens read from the prompt cache.

ReportTokens.name: cache_w5m
ReportTokens.doc: tokens written to the five minute cache.

ReportTokens.name: cache_w1h
ReportTokens.doc: tokens written to the one hour cache.

ReportModelCost.name: model
ReportModelCost.doc: the price table row, a key of analysis/pricing.py PRICES.

ReportModelCost.name: usd
ReportModelCost.doc: dollars at API list prices for this model's part of the tokens. Not a bill.

ReportModelCost.name: sessions_dominated
ReportModelCost.doc: sessions it wrote most of the output in.

ReportModelCost.name: commits
ReportModelCost.doc: commits from those dominated sessions only. Rows are never summed: a session's commits belong to the session, not to a model.

ReportModelCost.name: usd_per_commit
ReportModelCost.doc: dollars over commits across the dominated sessions. Null with no commit.

ReportMoney.name: usd
ReportMoney.doc: what the work would cost at API list prices. NOT A BILL: most people are on a subscription. Null on a refusal.

ReportMoney.name: basis
ReportMoney.doc: how it was priced: list prices, or list prices past the day they were last read. Null on a refusal.

ReportMoney.name: reason
ReportMoney.doc: why there is no price. Null when priced.

ReportMoney.name: prices_read_on
ReportMoney.doc: the day the price table was read, at 00:00Z. Always sent, so the phone can say how old a price is.

ReportMoney.name: priced_sessions
ReportMoney.doc: sessions with token counts and a model the price table knows.

ReportMoney.name: unpriced_sessions
ReportMoney.doc: sessions with token counts and a model it does not know. 0 when every such session was priced.

ReportMoney.name: usd_per_active_hour
ReportMoney.doc: dollars over active hours. Null without priced sessions or active time.

ReportMoney.name: usd_without_a_commit
ReportMoney.doc: dollars on sessions that ended with no commit. Null below the session floor.

ReportMoney.name: share_without_a_commit
ReportMoney.doc: that spend as a share of the spend on sessions with a git commit count.

ReportMoney.name: tokens
ReportMoney.doc: the five token buckets, summed over the sessions that reported them. Null when none did.

ReportMoney.name: lines_added
ReportMoney.doc: agent lines added. Null when no session carries a line count.

ReportMoney.name: lines_removed
ReportMoney.doc: agent lines removed. Null when no session carries a line count.

ReportMoney.name: lines_basis
ReportMoney.doc: what the line counts were read from.

ReportMoney.name: by_model
ReportMoney.doc: the spend split by price table row, most dollars first.

ReportBurnCause.name: cause
ReportBurnCause.doc: why a stretch that changed nothing cost what it did (analysis/burn.py).

ReportBurnCause.name: tokens
ReportBurnCause.doc: barren tokens this cause can claim.

ReportBurnCause.name: share
ReportBurnCause.doc: those tokens as a share of the barren tokens. Causes overlap, so the shares are never summed.

ReportBurnCause.name: segments
ReportBurnCause.doc: barren stretches this cause appeared in.

ReportBurn.name: share
ReportBurn.doc: the share of tokens spent in stretches where nothing was written, tested or committed. A floor: stretches the transcript cannot judge are counted apart. Null on a refusal.

ReportBurn.name: barren_tokens
ReportBurn.doc: tokens in those stretches. Null when no session reported token counts.

ReportBurn.name: tokens
ReportBurn.doc: tokens across every stretch. Null when no session reported token counts.

ReportBurn.name: unreadable_tokens
ReportBurn.doc: tokens in stretches the transcript cannot judge. Null unless every session supplied it.

ReportBurn.name: sessions
ReportBurn.doc: sessions whose token counts were split into stretches.

ReportBurn.name: needed
ReportBurn.doc: the session floor a below_session_floor refusal names.

ReportBurn.name: reason
ReportBurn.doc: why the share is null. Null when answered.

ReportBurn.name: causes
ReportBurn.doc: barren tokens by cause, in analysis/burn.py order. Null exactly when share is; an empty list only when barren_tokens is a measured 0.

ReportTerm.name: id
ReportTerm.doc: a glossary term, from analysis/vocab.py CATALOG. The phone has its word and definition.

ReportTerm.name: count
ReportTerm.doc: events that matched it. A lower bound where the digest cut a shell command.

ReportTerm.name: first_seen
ReportTerm.doc: the first time a session met it.

ReportVocab.name: terms
ReportVocab.doc: every term these sessions unlocked, in the order they were met.

ReportVocab.name: locked
ReportVocab.doc: catalog terms not met yet. Null on a refusal: there is nothing left to find over sessions nobody read.

ReportVocab.name: sessions
ReportVocab.doc: sessions with any event to read.

ReportVocab.name: shell_calls_cut
ReportVocab.doc: of those, how many the digest cut, so a command term may have happened unseen.

ReportVocab.name: reason
ReportVocab.doc: why there is no glossary. Null when answered.

ReportStackItem.name: id
ReportStackItem.doc: a stack item, from analysis/vocab.py STACK. The phone has its name.

ReportStackItem.name: evidence
ReportStackItem.doc: the first kind of evidence that put it here, in vocab.EVIDENCE order.

ReportStackItem.name: sessions
ReportStackItem.doc: sessions with event evidence for it. 0 when only a manifest names it.

ReportStackItem.name: first_seen
ReportStackItem.doc: its first event evidence. Null when only a manifest names it.

ReportStack.name: items
ReportStack.doc: what the project is made of, by category, then sessions.

ReportStack.name: sessions
ReportStack.doc: sessions with any event to read.

ReportStack.name: manifests
ReportStack.doc: dependency names read from manifests. A count, never a name.

ReportStack.name: shell_calls_cut
ReportStack.doc: of those, how many the digest cut.

ReportStack.name: reason
ReportStack.doc: why there is no stack. Null when answered.

fields.name: report_version
fields.doc: the spec version these rules came from. A retuned threshold is a recompute, not a migration.

fields.name: generated_at
fields.doc: when this was computed. A report describes a corpus as it stood.

fields.name: window_days
fields.doc: how far back the blocks below look.

fields.name: coverage
fields.doc: WHAT THESE NUMBERS ACTUALLY REST ON. A window is a question; this is how much of it the machine could answer. Both numbers are always reported and neither is judged: a reader who asked for 30 days and is told the transcripts span 2 knows immediately that the rest of their history is somewhere else. Null when the report was built with no profile to read it from.

fields.name: trend_headline
fields.doc: the one sentence version of the trends, phrased to match the window. Null when nothing moved enough to say.

fields.name: trends
fields.doc: you against you, two equal windows back to back. Never a window against all of history, which would report the trend of the corpus growing.

fields.name: agents
fields.doc: how many agents you ran and how much of it was at once. Null when no sidecar transcripts were found, which is the normal state for someone who has never delegated.

fields.name: contributions
fields.doc: commits split by whether an agent was in the room. Null below the minimum, never zero.

fields.name: quality
fields.doc: the two of DORA's four questions a transcript can answer. Null when no repository was resolved.

fields.name: prompting
fields.doc: how often a prompt lands cleanly, and nothing else. Null when neither pile has enough in it to be a rate.

fields.name: languages
fields.doc: what you actually build in, by lines the agent added. Null when no session in the window had a countable write.

fields.name: wrapped
fields.doc: the fifteen Wrapped cards, each answered or refused with a code. Null when the machine that sent this report does not compute it.

fields.name: money
fields.doc: what the work would cost at API list prices, beside its tokens and lines. Null when the machine that sent this report does not compute it.

fields.name: burn
fields.doc: the tokens spent in stretches that changed nothing, and why. Null when the machine that sent this report does not compute it.

fields.name: vocab
fields.doc: the glossary terms these sessions unlocked. Null when the machine that sent this report does not compute it.

fields.name: stack
fields.doc: what the project is made of. Null when the machine that sent this report does not compute it.
